reasoning_content:
`just setup` completes successfully (exit 0). Now let's run `just build` — this is the second main installation step in the guide. What it includes:
- build-frontend (build-domain-wasm + handbook-pdf + pnpm run build)
- build-keycloak-theme
- _compile-backend (cargo build --release --locked --bin green-ecolution with SQLX_OFFLINE=true)

This will be a long build (full Rust release build of the workspace). Let's kick it off in the background. In parallel, start `just infra-up` (all images are already pulled, and the valhalla tiles are ready too).

Note: infra-up runs `docker compose up -d`, starting up Postgres, Keycloak, pgAdmin, Valhalla, Streamlet, and Traefik.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && (nohup just build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 &) && echo "just build started"
